title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face
tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

judge.summary: The edit delivers a polished professional headshot while preserving her recognisable face, apparent age, skin texture, curls and expression.

must_haves.item: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
must_haves.why: The eyes, nose, closed-mouth smile, jawline and overall facial proportions closely match the source.

must_haves.item: Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
must_haves.why: Fine skin texture, facial marks and natural under-eye contours remain visible, without an apparent age change.

must_haves.item: Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
must_haves.why: Her dark curls and slight closed-mouth smile are clearly retained.

must_haves.item: The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
must_haves.why: A navy blazer and cream blouse replace the grey knitted sweater.

must_haves.item: The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.
must_haves.why: A neutral taupe backdrop replaces the park, and soft, balanced lighting provides natural facial definition.
